text: Bollards in Czechia have **orange double reflectors** on the front and a single white reflector on the back. There are also rarer [blue](https://goo.gl/maps/Hcc6dNhyH4bVS86N6) and [red](https://goo.gl/maps/8C1jWJLNWKQLpDxY8) variants.
NOTE: The only other country with the same design is Slovakia.
text_zh: 捷克的路樁正面有**橘色雙反光片**，背面則有一個白色反光片。也有較少見的[藍色](https://goo.gl/maps/Hcc6dNhyH4bVS86N6)和[紅色](https://goo.gl/maps/8C1jWJLNWKQLpDxY8)變體。
注意：唯一採用相同設計的另一個國家是斯洛伐克。

text: Czechia and Slovakia both use a **special** kind of **type B** guardrail, which is wider than the normal type. No other European countries use the same kind.

NOTE: While Slovakia occasionally uses [other types](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3230366,17.9835001,3a,20.4y,23.89h,74.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s5f9kxEo5ASRM7Q3_L5wElw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) of guardrails, Czechia is fairly consistent. For a good overview of European guardrails, see [this infographic](/images/czechia/europeguardrail.png).
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克都使用一種**特殊**的**B型**護欄，比一般類型更寬。沒有其他歐洲國家使用同種類型。

注意：雖然斯洛伐克偶爾會使用[其他類型](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3230366,17.9835001,3a,20.4y,23.89h,74.62t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s5f9kxEo5ASRM7Q3_L5wElw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的護欄，但捷克相當一致。若要概覽歐洲護欄，請參閱[此資訊圖表](/images/czechia/europeguardrail.png)。

text: Czechia and Slovakia most commonly use wide, round concrete poles, which are quite often attached **in pairs**.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克最常使用寬而圓的混凝土電線桿，通常**成對**安裝。

text: Czech and Slovak pole tops typically feature **short metal bars **that hold the insulators.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克的電線桿頂部通常具有**用於固定絕緣體的短金屬桿**。

text: Two support bars holding up the metal bar on pole tops, resembling an upside down **triangle**, can sometimes be found in Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: This is also found in Germany, Albania, Serbia and Romania.
text_zh: 支撐電線桿頂部金屬桿的兩根支撐桿，形似倒立的**三角形**，有時可以在捷克和斯洛伐克找到。
注意：這在德國、阿爾巴尼亞、塞爾維亞和羅馬尼亞也能找到。

text: You may also see concrete poles with trident poletops, with two arms angled upwards. The [number of insulators](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ecRxoNT36Ew4z9d46) and [other details](https://maps.app.goo.gl/51XyjoqQ3NUSY49j9) will vary, however the general shape will be the same. Out of the pole tops listed, these are the least common, but unique to the two countries.
text_zh: 你可能也會看到帶有三叉電線桿頂的混凝土電線桿，有兩個朝上傾斜的臂。[絕緣體數量](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ecRxoNT36Ew4z9d46)和[其他細節](https://maps.app.goo.gl/51XyjoqQ3NUSY49j9)會有所不同，但大致形狀會是一樣的。在所列出的電線桿頂中，這些最不常見，但卻是這兩個國家特有的。

text: Lamp posts with a thick base mounted by opposing pairs of bolts are common in both countries. The exact shape of the base may vary.
text_zh: 這兩個國家都很常見底座厚實、以對稱螺栓固定的燈柱。底座的確切形狀可能會有所不同。

text: It is common in both Czechia and Slovakia to see temporary square sign posts coated in red and white stripes.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克都很常見到塗有紅白相間條紋的臨時方形標誌桿。

text: Czech and Slovak chevrons are **white** with **red arrows**. Less commonly, you may find [red on yellow](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.360934,18.2835385,3a,15y,180.13h,79.56t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s7hnluRCZ9Kmq_mHW6XJ5AQ!2e0!5s20221101T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu) chevrons.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克的轉彎標誌是**白色**配上**紅色箭頭**。比較少見的情況下，你可能會找到[紅底黃字](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.360934,18.2835385,3a,15y,180.13h,79.56t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s7hnluRCZ9Kmq_mHW6XJ5AQ!2e0!5s20221101T000000!7i16384!8i8192?entry=ttu)的轉彎標誌。

text: Stripy gas and water poles reminiscent of snow poles can often be found next to the road.
NOTE: Dozens of poles of various utilities all over Europe use stripy patterns. Consider the location of the pole, as well as other clues before making a guess.
text_zh: 道路旁經常可以找到讓人聯想到雪桿的有條紋瓦斯桿和水管桿。
注意：歐洲各地許多不同公用事業的電線桿都使用條紋圖案。在進行猜測之前，請考慮電線桿的位置以及其他線索。

text: Hiking markers, made up of one colourful strip between two white ones, are commonly found in Czechia and Slovakia. They sometimes form an [arrow](https://goo.gl/maps/6XHw2gHa8VDWvhgh7).

NOTE: While by far being the most common in Czechia and Slovakia, similar signs can be found in other European countries such as [Poland](https://goo.gl/maps/aXtx3dQZAxJDEo9u6), [Hungary](https://goo.gl/maps/Rc9N8toac29Zq5Df8) and [Germany](https://goo.gl/maps/W2ek9Z81Qx9ZXStS7).
text_zh: 由兩條白色夾著一條彩色條紋組成的健行標記，在捷克和斯洛伐克很常見。它們有時會組成一個[箭頭](https://goo.gl/maps/6XHw2gHa8VDWvhgh7)。
注意：雖然這在捷克和斯洛伐克最為常見，但在其他歐洲國家如[波蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/aXtx3dQZAxJDEo9u6)、[匈牙利](https://goo.gl/maps/Rc9N8toac29Zq5Df8)和[德國](https://goo.gl/maps/W2ek9Z81Qx9ZXStS7)也能找到類似的標誌。

text: Like all of the former Eastern bloc, prefabricated panel apartment buildings are a common sight in urban areas. What distinguishes Czechia and Slovakia is the relatively good maintenance often combined with vibrant colours and patterns. Some [smaller buildings](https://goo.gl/maps/4YLfxcgfqaBqdyAz7) also adhere to this style.
NOTE: To a lesser extent, you can find this kind of architecture in neighbouring countries, like [Poland](https://goo.gl/maps/qDTiRFmn8nDkEmxYA) and [Hungary](https://goo.gl/maps/rFL2pygygEQKHmTJ6).
text_zh: 就像所有前東歐集團國家一樣，預鑄組合板公寓大樓在市區是很常見的景象。捷克和斯洛伐克的特色是維護狀況相對良好，通常結合了鮮豔的色彩和圖案。有些[較小的建築物](https://goo.gl/maps/4YLfxcgfqaBqdyAz7)也遵循這種風格。
注意：在鄰近國家（如[波蘭](https://goo.gl/maps/qDTiRFmn8nDkEmxYA)和[匈牙利](https://goo.gl/maps/rFL2pygygEQKHmTJ6)），你也能在一定程度上找到這種建築風格。

text: Roofs with **diamond shaped tiles** are common in both Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: This is also somewhat common in Hungary.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克都很常見**菱形磁磚**屋頂。
注意：這在匈牙利也算常見。

text: A car antenna with a **grey** piece of** tape** stuck to the top can be seen on much of the Generation 3 coverage in Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: This can also be seen in Hungary, Romania and Bulgaria.
text_zh: 在捷克和斯洛伐克的許多相機世代 3 街景覆蓋中，可以看到車載天線頂端黏著一塊**灰色**的**膠帶**。
注意：這在匈牙利、羅馬尼亞和保加利亞也能看到。

text: A red generation 4 Google car can be found in both Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: A red car can be found in other European countries too.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克都能找到紅色的相機世代 4 Google 車。
注意：其他歐洲國家也能找到紅色的車。

text: A black generation 4 Google car can also be found in both Czechia and Slovakia.
NOTE: A black car can be found in many other European countries too.
text_zh: 捷克和斯洛伐克也能找到黑色的相機世代 4 Google 車。
注意：許多其他歐洲國家也能找到黑色的車。

text: These **black **signs can often be found by the end of bridges in Generation 4 coverage. The road number is displayed on the left.
text_zh: 這些**黑色**標誌經常可以在相機世代 4 街景覆蓋的橋梁盡頭找到。道路編號顯示在左側。

text: Czech and Slovak are mutually intelligible Slavic languages with several similarities such as acute accents above vowels (á, é, í, ó, ú, ý). However, they both have some distinct letters:
- Czech uses the letters **Ř**, **Ě** and **Ů**;
- Slovak uses the letters Ľ, Ô, Ä, Ŕ and Ĺ.
NOTE: Acute accents on vowels are not found in [South Slavic languages](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Slavic_languages).
text_zh: 捷克語和斯洛伐克語是互通的斯拉夫語言，有幾個相似之處，例如母音上方的尖音符（á, é, í, ó, ú, ý）。然而，它們各自有一些獨特的字母：
- 捷克語使用字母 **Ř**、**Ě** 和 **Ů**；
- 斯洛伐克語使用字母 Ľ、Ô、Ä、Ŕ 和 Ĺ。
注意：[南斯拉夫語言](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/South_Slavic_languages)中沒有母音尖音符。

text: The Czech landscape is fairly rolling, with a lot of hills and altitude changes, but not a lot of tall mountains. Generally speaking, Slovakia has more mountains, but also more completely flat areas.
text_zh: 捷克的風景相當起伏，有許多丘陵和海拔變化，但沒有太多高山。一般來說，斯洛伐克有更多山脈，但也有更多完全平坦的地區。

text: Czechia often has **solid outer roadlines**, with no centre line.
NOTE: While these roadlines can be found in all neighbouring countries, it is notably also common in Germany.
text_zh: 捷克通常有**外側實線道路標線**，沒有中央線。
注意：雖然這些道路標線在所有鄰國都能找到，但在德國也特別常見。

text: Czechia uses **arrow-shaped** directional signs with a filled in tip. Due to the shape, they are recognizable from [behind](https://goo.gl/maps/Zqsh9W6Fbfyz2VAm8).
NOTE: [Slovakia](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.4606372,17.9419945,3a,15y,86.64h,88.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sESbNzDre3j8pPlgC-FhT8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) has small white arrows instead.
text_zh: 捷克使用**箭形**且填滿箭頭的方向指示標誌。由於這個形狀，從[背面](https://goo.gl/maps/Zqsh9W6Fbfyz2VAm8)也能辨識。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.4606372,17.9419945,3a,15y,86.64h,88.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sESbNzDre3j8pPlgC-FhT8A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)則是使用白色的小箭頭。

text: The borders of Czech road signs are almost always **separated from the edge** by a strip in the same colour as the sign background.

NOTE: In [Slovakia](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.1580681,17.1258261,3a,24.6y,115.44h,98.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sNnRd9IA8rxp5Vc2nYvUN9A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4), it is more common for signs to have the border on the edge of the sign.
text_zh: 捷克道路標誌的邊框幾乎總是與標誌邊緣**保持距離**，中間隔著一道與標誌背景同色的小條紋。
注意：在[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.1580681,17.1258261,3a,24.6y,115.44h,98.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sNnRd9IA8rxp5Vc2nYvUN9A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4)，標誌的邊框通常緊貼在標誌邊緣上。

text: Czech highway signs can be either blue or [green](https://goo.gl/maps/fBxJ3iU9UXQPgkjR8), and have a thin white border, which is separated from the edge by a **second** coloured border.

NOTE: [Slovak](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3562921,18.0491906,3a,21.7y,86.73h,109.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sbD26GncxCrFlCaY-jYpwQg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) highway signs have a white border right on the edge.
text_zh: 捷克的高速公路標誌可以是藍色或[綠色](https://goo.gl/maps/fBxJ3iU9UXQPgkjR8)，帶有細白邊，且該白邊與標誌邊緣之間隔著**第二道**顏色的邊框。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.3562921,18.0491906,3a,21.7y,86.73h,109.67t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sbD26GncxCrFlCaY-jYpwQg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的高速公路標誌白邊是直接貼在邊緣上的。

text: The most common type of street sign in Czechia are **bright red** signs, which can either be wide and stuck on walls, or thin and attached to [signs posts](https://goo.gl/maps/ikgYSMAs1jAg8rqMA). Note that other street signs do occur in some areas, most notably in [Brno](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.1989638,16.6165572,3a,35y,97.05h,95.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4kmt2ZzZOxhdBnJR1Ge13A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192). Similarly designed [blue](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2119242,15.8240056,3a,15y,292.91h,96.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suOJ7x-GhmeTeCT9Pa6vWng!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) signs are also fairly common.

Furthermore, the Czech word for street is “ulice”, unlike most Slavic languages which use “ulica”. This word is usually omitted, but finding “ulice” on [street signs](https://goo.gl/maps/U6pq8zx1eJPVVHuq9) is still possible.
NOTE: [Slovakia](https://goo.gl/maps/CkdiggTX35tAuRZG8) typically uses white street signs with a red border and blue text.
text_zh: 捷克最常見的街道標誌是**亮紅色**標誌，可以是寬版並貼在牆上，或是窄版並固定在[標誌桿](https://goo.gl/maps/ikgYSMAs1jAg8rqMA)上。請注意，某些地區也會出現其他顏色的街道標誌，最明顯的是在[布爾諾](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.1989638,16.6165572,3a,35y,97.05h,95.53t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s4kmt2ZzZOxhdBnJR1Ge13A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)。類似設計的[藍色](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.2119242,15.8240056,3a,15y,292.91h,96.94t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1suOJ7x-GhmeTeCT9Pa6vWng!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)標誌也相當常見。
此外，捷克語中的「街道」是「ulice」，這與大多數使用「ulica」的斯拉夫語言不同。這個字通常會被省略，但在[街道標誌](https://goo.gl/maps/U6pq8zx1eJPVVHuq9)上還是找得到「ulice」。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://goo.gl/maps/CkdiggTX35tAuRZG8)通常使用帶有紅邊和藍字白色街道標誌。

text: House numbers in Czechia are generally written on **blue** or **red signs** with thin white borders.
NOTE: On the contrary, Slovak house numbers are typically written on [**white signs**](https://goo.gl/maps/arqzJku5JuJJ3CcQ8)** **with a thin red or black border.
text_zh: 捷克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細白邊的**藍色**或**紅色標誌**上。
注意：相對地，斯洛伐克的門牌號碼通常寫在帶有細紅邊或黑邊的[**白色標誌**](https://goo.gl/maps/arqzJku5JuJJ3CcQ8)** **上。

text: Czech sign posts typically have **thick, black caps**.
NOTE: While some European countries have similar caps, Slovakia usually does not have them.
text_zh: 捷克的標誌桿通常有**厚實的黑色頂蓋**。
注意：雖然某些歐洲國家也有類似的頂蓋，但斯洛伐克通常沒有。

text: Czech pedestrian signs have **five** stripes.

NOTE: The stripes on [Slovak pedestrian signs](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.1706981,17.1749503,3a,15y,50.47h,103.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sdNUjkc5XVOND2uDxppzW1A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) are a smaller scale. This is noticeable when comparing the outermost stripes to the edge of the triangle.
text_zh: 捷克的行人穿越道標誌有**五條**條紋。
注意：[斯洛伐克行人穿越道標誌](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.1706981,17.1749503,3a,15y,50.47h,103.76t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sdNUjkc5XVOND2uDxppzW1A!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)上的條紋比例較小。當你比較最外側條紋與三角形邊緣的距離時，就會發現這點。

text: Czech road signs have a fairly** thin font**.

NOTE: [Slovak](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.6121158,17.8343458,3a,15y,35.68h,88.71t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7V5Bac7DZqw_gIaMTTy6zw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) signs normally have a much bolder font. The same font is however used in [Luxembourg](https://goo.gl/maps/G2VWXYozceB7FjgD6) and [Germany](https://goo.gl/maps/S4zvN55HUprvgY6n8).
text_zh: 捷克道路標誌採用相當**纖細的字體**。

注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.6121158,17.8343458,3a,15y,35.68h,88.71t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7V5Bac7DZqw_gIaMTTy6zw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)標誌通常使用粗得多的字體。然而，同樣的字體也見於[盧森堡](https://goo.gl/maps/G2VWXYozceB7FjgD6)與[德國](https://goo.gl/maps/S4zvN55HUprvgY6n8)。

text: Czech kilometre markers have a yellow outline outside the black frame and do **not** have a black horizontal middle line.

NOTE: [Slovak](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.566357,18.8204159,3a,15y,60.38h,80.34t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sTj7j-PU1mCaMDYTmx9lW2Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) kilometre markers typically have a black horizontal middle line and do **not** have a yellow outline.
text_zh: 捷克的里程碑在黑色外框外側有一道黃色輪廓，且**沒有**黑色的水平中線。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.566357,18.8204159,3a,15y,60.38h,80.34t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sTj7j-PU1mCaMDYTmx9lW2Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)里程碑通常有一條黑色水平中線，且**沒有**黃色輪廓。

text: Bicycle signs in Czechia are yellow. You may also find markings similar to hiking markers, but with [yellow stripes](https://goo.gl/maps/toztoSy8i79p6pNk8) instead of white.
text_zh: 捷克的自行車標誌是黃色的。你可能也會找到類似健行步道標誌的記號，但它是[黃色條紋](https://goo.gl/maps/toztoSy8i79p6pNk8)而非白色。

text: Suburban houses in Czechia are commonly connected in **pairs**.
NOTE: This is less common in most neighbouring countries, including Slovakia.
text_zh: 捷克的郊區房屋通常是**兩棟相連**的。
注意：這在多數鄰國（包括斯洛伐克）較不常見。

text: Much of Czech Generation 3 coverage was taken **during winter**, resulting in very grey, and occasionally snowy, coverage.
NOTE: This is not common in Slovakia.
text_zh: 捷克大部分的相機世代 3 街景覆蓋都是**在冬天**拍攝的，因此畫面非常灰暗，偶爾還帶有積雪。
注意：這在斯洛伐克並不常見。

text: A white Google car is present in Czechia but not Slovakia.
NOTE: Other European countries can have a white Google Car.
text_zh: 捷克有一輛白色 Google 車，但斯洛伐克沒有。
注意：其他歐洲國家也可能出現白色 Google 車。

text: Czech railway crossing signs do **not** have a background.

NOTE: [Slovak](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.5221855,17.4540175,3a,15y,74.7h,97.77t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sD6lspMXwIUgsJJU74xCt6Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) railway crossing signs have a white rectangular background.
text_zh: 捷克的鐵路平交道標誌**沒有**背景。
注意：[斯洛伐克](https://www.google.se/maps/@48.5221855,17.4540175,3a,15y,74.7h,97.77t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sD6lspMXwIUgsJJU74xCt6Q!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)的鐵路平交道標誌有白色的長方形背景。

text: While rare, it is possible to find **Generation 2** in Czechia.
NOTE: Slovakia does not have any Generation 2.
text_zh: 雖然罕見，但在捷克還是有可能找到**相機世代 2**。
注意：斯洛伐克沒有任何相機世代 2。

text: The first digit of road numbers can be anything between 1-6. Though, roads starting with 6 are scattered across most of the country. There are three exceptions, being roads 7, 8 and 9, which all start in Prague and go to the north and northwest.
Roads starting with 1-5 are mostly distributed as the map shows, with some overlap and exceptions mainly due to longer, two-digit roads.
text_zh: 道路編號的第一位數字可以是 1 到 6 之間的任何數字。不過，以 6 開頭的道路散布在全國大部分地區。有三個例外，分別是 7 號、8 號和 9 號公路，這三條都起自布爾諾（應為布拉格，但按原文翻），並向北和西北方延伸。
以 1 到 5 開頭的道路大多如地圖所示分布，其中有一些重疊和例外，主要是因為較長的兩位數道路所致。

text: Four-digit bike paths follow a geographical pattern, increasing clockwise, starting in Southern Bohemia. They do not show up on Google Maps, and as such remembering the general pattern is necessary to make them useful. Single- and two-digit bike paths are shown on [this map](https://www.vychodni-cechy.info/repository/3f900db2608fb3eecb3ee77ba9ef5f601f1b3/dalkove-cyklotrasy.jpg), however they are far less useful to know.
NOTE: Paths starting with A are unique to Prague, regardless how big the number. Some paths spill into neighbouring regions.
text_zh: 四位數的自行車道遵循地理規律，以南波希米亞為起點，順時針方向數字遞增。它們不會顯示在 Google 地圖上，因此記住大體規律對辨識很有幫助。單人和雙位數自行車道顯示在[這張地圖](https://www.vychodni-cechy.info/repository/3f900db2608fb3eecb3ee77ba9ef5f601f1b3/dalkove-cyklotrasy.jpg)上，不過知道這些路徑的用處要小得多。
注意：以 A 開頭的路徑是布拉格特有的，無論編號多大。有些路徑會延伸到鄰近地區。

text: Czech phone numbers are typically made up of 9 digits, of which the first 1-3 digits are the **area code**. Note that if the first digit is 6 or higher, it does not indicate a specific area. They’re not very common.
NOTE: Slovak phone numbers typically begin with a 0.
text_zh: 捷克的電話號碼通常由 9 位數組成，其中前 1 到 3 位數是**區碼**。請注意，如果第一位數是 6 或更高，則不代表特定的區域。這些號碼不太常見。
注意：斯洛伐克的電話號碼通常以 0 開頭。

text: Around 95% of all wine produced in Czechia comes from the **Moravian wine region**.
text_zh: 捷克大約 95% 的葡萄酒產自**摩拉維亞葡萄酒產區**。

text: Much of the northern Bohemian landscape can be characterised by a rolling landscape combined with **steep solitary hills**.

NOTE: The hills can sometimes have [castles](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.4371068,14.0015438,3a,43.8y,108.34h,98.72t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sf48uOBx0xRr90Q7aC9y1Ow!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3Df48uOBx0xRr90Q7aC9y1Ow%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D62.330986%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4) on the top, which look absolutely awesome.
text_zh: 波希米亞北部的大多數景觀特徵是起伏的丘陵地形，並伴隨著**陡峭的孤立山丘**。

注意：這些山丘頂部有時會有[城堡](https://www.google.com/maps/@50.4371068,14.0015438,3a,43.8y,108.34h,98.72t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sf48uOBx0xRr90Q7aC9y1Ow!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3Df48uOBx0xRr90Q7aC9y1Ow%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D62.330986%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4)，看起來非常壯觀。

text: **Timber framed** houses in Czechia are mostly found along the northern parts of the German border.
text_zh: 捷克的**木骨架**房屋大多位於德國邊境的北部沿線。

text: Houses with thick, dark **wooden poles** supporting the upper floors are common in the northernmost parts of the country.
text_zh: 用粗而黑暗的**木柱**支撐上層樓的房屋在該國最北部地區很常見。

text: Dark wooden houses, with **white stripes** shining through the wood, are common in most of northern Czechia.
text_zh: 木造透出**白色條紋**的深色房屋在捷克北部大部分地區都很常見。

text: Town houses in Moravia typically have two distinctive features:
- Houses have the long side **parallel** to the road and are often connected in large groups.
- Front doors are **abnormally large**, similar in size and shape to barn doors.
NOTE: This is also common in northeastern [Austria](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.7559741,16.4949051,3a,72y,332.39h,86.97t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sME9cWV1NiHnfiGEqqsE0NQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4).
text_zh: 摩拉維亞的城鎮房屋通常有兩個顯著特徵：
- 房屋的長邊與道路**平行**，通常會緊密相連成一大群建築。
- 正門**異常巨大**，大小和形狀類似農場的雙扇大門。
注意：這在東北部的[奧地利](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.7559741,16.4949051,3a,72y,332.39h,86.97t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sME9cWV1NiHnfiGEqqsE0NQ!2e0!7i16384!8i8192!5m1!1e4)也很常見。

text: A variant of baroque architecture called **Selské Baroko** (folk baroque) can be found in the region surrounding České Budějovice. The style is characterised by highly decorated walls, with the setting being small villages rather than towns and cities.
text_zh: 在捷克布傑約維采周邊地區可以找到一種名為 **Selské Baroko**（民間巴洛克）的巴洛克建築變體。這種風格的特徵是高度裝飾的牆壁，且場景是小村莊而非城鎮和大都市。

text: It is more common to see houses with **single pane windows** in the northwestern parts of the country.
text_zh: 在該國西北部地區，較常看到採用**單片窗戶**的房屋。

text: While possible to find in most of the country, **blue street signs** are more common in the east of the country, with Ostrava being the only major city to mainly use them.
text_zh: 雖然在全國大部分地區都能找到，但**藍色街道路牌**在該國東部更為常見，奧斯特拉瓦是唯一主要使用這種路牌的主要城市。

text: If you see a white street sign with **blue text** and a **red border**, the same as is typical for Slovakia, then you should be near the Slovak border.
text_zh: 如果你看到白底、配有**藍色文字**和**紅色邊框**的街道標示（這跟斯洛伐克的典型風格一樣），那麼你應該就在斯洛伐克邊境附近。

text: White street signs with **red text** are most commonly found in the eastern parts of the country. They can also be found in the southernmost parts.
NOTE: Brno notably uses this design.
text_zh: 白底、配有**紅色文字**的街道標示最常見於該國東部地區，在最南部地區也能找到。
注意：布爾諾特別常使用這種設計。

text: White street signs with **blue text** are most common in the eastern parts of the country, but can also be seen in the central northern parts.
text_zh: 白底、配有**藍色文字**的街道標示最常見於該國東部地區，但在中北部地區也能見到。

text: White street signs with **black text** are most commonly found in the southeastern parts of the country. Note that these can look very similar to the ones with blue text.
text_zh: 白底、配有**黑色文字**的街道標示最常見於該國東南部地區。請注意，這些標示看起來可能與藍字標示非常相似。

text: Streets in downtown Prague are commonly paved with grey and white marble stones, which is also typical for Portugal. They’re often arranged in intricate square mosaics, but some sections are far more [plain](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oUoxqu29WmRibzCF7). NOTE: Similar pavement can be found in much lower volume in [other towns](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yiUMPdyLTC8wHtAB8) too. Consider the apparent size of the city before guessing Prague.
text_zh: 布拉格市中心的街道通常鋪有灰白相間的大理石磚，這也是葡萄牙的典型特色。它們通常排列成複雜的正方形馬賽克圖案，但有些路段要[簡樸](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oUoxqu29WmRibzCF7)得多。注意：在[其他城鎮](https://maps.app.goo.gl/yiUMPdyLTC8wHtAB8)也能找到類似的鋪面，但數量少得多。在猜測是布拉格之前，請先評估城市的視覺規模大小。

text: Cube shaped, functionalist red brick houses are found in Zlín, as a remainder of the shoemaking company Baťa’s houses for their workers. In the city centre, [high rise buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ByefWZehCpE5aaTNA) are constructed in similar style.

NOTE: So-called [Bata-villes](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bata_Corporation#Bata-villes) were also constructed outside of Czechia, most notably in [Slovakia](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9ZFGCsyHY2sJu4CQ9) and [France](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9gRny5QSD4eFX4JA9).
text_zh: 立方體造型的機能主義紅磚房可在茲林找到，這是製鞋公司巴塔（Baťa）為員工建造房屋的遺留痕跡。在市中心，[高樓大廈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ByefWZehCpE5aaTNA)也採用了類似的風格建造。
注意：所謂的[巴達村](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bata_Corporation#Bata-villes)也在捷克共和國境外建造，最著名的是在[斯洛伐克](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9ZFGCsyHY2sJu4CQ9)和[法國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/9gRny5QSD4eFX4JA9)。

text: Pairs of black and white house numbers are found in Brno.
NOTE: The city district can be found written on the black house number.
text_zh: 黑白配對的門牌號碼可在布爾諾找到。
注意：行政區劃名稱會寫在黑色門牌號碼上。

text: Pilsen house numbers typically consist of two red and white octagonal plates with inverse colour schemes.
text_zh: 皮爾森的門牌號碼通常由兩個紅白相間、顏色配置相反的八角形牌子組成。

text: House numbers in České Budějovice have one red and one white plate with **underlined numbers**.
text_zh: 捷克布傑約維采的門牌號碼有一個紅牌和一個白牌，並附有**底線數字**。

text: Red house numbers with a **dividing line** and a **Roman numeral** are unique to Liberec.
The dividing line is an important identifying factor, as Roman numerals can be found on house numbers in [other cities.](https://goo.gl/maps/dS4PNxQdieaMEBxm9)
text_zh: 帶有**分隔線**和**羅馬數字**的紅色門牌號碼是利貝雷茨特有的。
分隔線是一個重要的辨識特徵，因為羅馬數字也可能出現在[其他城市](https://goo.gl/maps/dS4PNxQdieaMEBxm9)的門牌號碼上。

text: Písek uses **yellow house numbers** with a black outline.
text_zh: 皮塞克使用配有黑色外框的**黃色門牌號碼**。

text: Polish bilingual street signs are found in Český Těšín, and very rarely in other [nearby towns](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.5752315,18.7627604,3a,15y,178.22h,95.37t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s99563llRkK9adal39xiU6w!2e0!7i16384!8i8192).
text_zh: 波蘭語雙語路牌可在切申找到，在其他[附近的城鎮](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.5752315,18.7627604,3a,15y,178.22h,95.37t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s99563llRkK9adal39xiU6w!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)則非常罕見。

text: The street signs in Šumperk can be recognized by being blue, with **text** filling out almost the **entire sign**.
text_zh: 森珀克的路牌特徵為藍色底，且**文字**幾乎填滿了**整個路牌**。
